topics.title: Knowing the world: stimuli, sense modalities and thresholds
topics.ncert_sections: Knowing the World; Nature and Varieties of Stimulus; Sense Modalities

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the seven sense organs, including the two deep senses, and define sensation and sense modality.
Explain the absolute threshold and why it is estimated over many trials.
Distinguish the difference threshold from the absolute threshold in a given situation.
Describe alertness, concentration and search as properties of attention, and its focus and fringe.
Classify external and internal factors that determine selective attention.
Compare the filter, filter-attenuation and multimode theories of selective attention.

topics.title: Sustained attention, span of attention, divided attention and ADHD

concepts.learning_objective: Explain vigilance and the factors that facilitate or inhibit sustained attention.
State the span of attention and explain when attention can be divided.
Describe the features, causes and management of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.

topics.title: Perceptual processes and the perceiver
topics.ncert_sections: Perceptual Processes; Processing Approaches in Perception; The Perceiver

concepts.learning_objective: Define perception and distinguish bottom-up from top-down processing.
Explain how motivation, expectations and cultural experience shape perception.
Distinguish field dependent and field independent cognitive styles.
Explain the Gestalt view of form perception and the features of figure and ground.
Apply the Gestalt principles of organisation to visual patterns.

topics.title: Perception of space, depth and distance
topics.ncert_sections: Perception of Space, Depth, and Distance; Monocular Cues and Binocular Cues

concepts.learning_objective: Identify monocular (pictorial and kinetic) cues to depth in given scenes.
Explain retinal disparity, convergence and accommodation as cues to depth.
Distinguish size, shape and brightness constancy.
Explain geometrical and apparent movement illusions and why illusions occur.
Interpret cross-cultural findings on susceptibility to visual illusions.
Explain how cultural exposure to pictures affects pictorial perception.
